Quick Diagnostic enables SDK debug output with traigent.configure(logging_level="DEBUG"); TRAIGENT_LOG_LEVEL alone is applied only by configure()/initialize()/the CLI, so on a decorated run it changed LiteLLM's verbosity, not Traigent's. No-trials step 4 and the environment check follow; logging-config.md's default-level row matches a decorated run.

TRAIGENT_MOCK_LLM=true is marked deprecated (0.27.0 DeprecationWarning, scheduled for removal) where it is taught; the full mock dry-run example uses enable_mock_mode_for_quickstart(), and the environment check reports the in-code mock flag.

New entry for a cost_limit stop caused by unmeasured cost (stop message 'per-trial cost unknown: fallback trial limit'), where raising cost_limit does not help; Option 1 now says so; error-reference points to it.

SDK 0.30.0 shipped: 'Run stopped because cost was not measured' now names warning COST_UNMEASURED_TRIAL_LIMIT_REACHED and documents the explicit max_trials/max_total_examples consent path (warning COST_UNMEASURED_TRIALS_RAN) that lifts the fallback trial limit (Traigent/Traigent#2441, #2447). Gated on the SDK 0.30.0 release; see docs/version-matrix.md.
